title: Artemis III: A Moon Landing Rehearsal in Earth Orbit
description: NASA says Artemis III, planned for 2027, will keep four astronauts in Earth orbit to dock Orion with test versions of Blue Origin's Blue Moon and SpaceX's Starship. A crewed landing is a 2028 target, not a confirmed date.

beats.vo: Before anyone lands on the Moon, NASA wants to rehearse the hard part right here in Earth orbit.

beats.text: Artemis III tests two lunar landers
beats.vo: Artemis three is planned for next year. Four astronauts in Orion will dock with test versions of two landers, then check the Blue Moon cabin. It stays in Earth orbit, with no landing. A crewed landing is a twenty twenty eight target.
Follow for a daily dose of engineering.

caption:
Before the Moon, a rehearsal in Earth orbit. 🚀
NASA's Artemis III (planned 2027) will dock Orion with test versions of Blue Origin's Blue Moon and SpaceX's Starship. No landing yet — a crewed landing is the 2028 target.
Why it matters: docking and cabin checks are cheaper to fix in orbit than at the Moon.
